Unleashed on an unsuspecting public, the Colossus is the be-all-end-all Russian/Civil War Muff-style fuzz. It is ridiculously tweakable, insanely versatile, and packed with 10 tons of colossal mojo. Rich harmonic drenched chords, sweet singing leads, sludgey stoner goodness, filthy bluesy mcnasties, pumpkin-flavored raunch. You name it, it does it. It features a 3-way toggle for different EQ voicings, as well as a full range “Mids” control to help you cut through the mix in a live setting. As with all Mojo Hand FX pedals, the Colossus comes in a die cast aluminum enclosure that has been professionally powder coated and printed at our facility. Controls: -Tone -Gain -Mids -Volume -3 way tone toggle (Center - standard. Down - more bass. Up - most bass) -True bypass switching Power: -Standard center negative 9V DC supply, or 9V battery (neither included) -Current draw: ~12mA Dimensions: -4.8" L x 2.62" W x 1.55" H Related Products Out of stock One Ton Bee - 60s Style Fuzz $125.00 Add to Cart 1979 - OpAmp Fuzz $169.00 Add to Cart Iron Bell - "Gilmour" Fuzz $169.00 Rounder - A Nod to a Rare Fuzz Close × OK Footer Start Categories PEDALS Information Merchandise Retailers About Us INFO & SUPPORT Sitemap Follow Us Mojo Hand FX 514 Lincoln Ave Holland, MI 49423 © 2026 Mojo Hand FX
